name: Threshold Lines — Cross-Category Combat Parlay Board
subcategory: cross-category parlay betting — human vs. machine matchups
description: Threshold Lines is a gray-market parlay board specializing in cross-category combat wagers — bets that span human augmented fighters, unaugmented athletes, and autonomous Behemoths within a single multi-leg ticket, including hypothetical human-versus-machine matchup odds that no licensed operator will book. Operating through a mesh-distributed anonymous ledger with physical cashout nodes in Tier 1-2 bar networks, the board gained notoriety for its 'Convergence Lines' — parlays that require correctly predicting outcomes across BLOODWORK Circuit, TITAN COMPACT, and WRECK PROTOCOL in the same weekend. A correct six-leg Convergence Line has paid out as much as Φ180,000 on a Φ50 stake.
story_hooks: A bettor who correctly called five legs of a Convergence Line is being followed — someone wants to know if they have advance knowledge of fight outcomes or are genuinely that good at analysis.
Threshold Lines' hypothetical human-versus-machine odds on a specific Behemoth unit have been suspiciously accurate — accurate enough that someone wonders if they're not hypothetical.
The board's anonymous ledger cashout node at a Shelf canteen is raided, and the owner — who knew nothing about the operation — is now holding evidence that implicates people at multiple tier levels.
